The detail coefficients $w$ are computed by predicting the even-indexed samples from the odd-indexed samples (or vice versa, depending on the specific subdivision convention, but the formula uses the lifting operator).

The approximation coefficients $s$ are updated using the newly computed detail coefficients to preserve moments (such as the mean).
